sources.snippet: Compared to `colpali`, it is trained with right padding for queries to fix unwanted tokens in the query encoding. It also stems from the fixed `vidore/colpaligemma-3b-mix-448-base` to guarantee deterministic projection layer initialization. The data is the same as the ColPali data described in the paper.
